Under Rule 6c-11(d), an ETF relying on the rule must keep records of its custom-basket and exchanged-basket activity. These include the identity and quantity of each security or other asset in each basket, the date and time of each creation or redemption, and the basis for any custom basket, including the policies and procedures governing those baskets and the records showing compliance with them.

The records must be kept for at least five years, with the first two in an easily accessible place. That retention period follows the general 1940 Act books-and-records framework.
